title: Kimi (Moonshot)
description:
A component that connects to Moonshot AI's Kimi large language models for 
advanced natural language processing. It enables text generation, long-context 
reasoning, summarization, and tool use. The Kimi K2 family offers a 256K context 
window with thinking and non-thinking modes and strong agentic performance, while 
the classic Moonshot v1 models provide cost-effective options across 8K, 32K, and 
128K context sizes. The component is suitable for integrating intelligent 
reasoning and content generation into pipelines where long context and accuracy 
are key.
